API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingCloud Vips Resource Get Recommended Vips Grouped By Dc
Cloud Vips Resource Get Recommended Vips Grouped By Dc
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/vips/groupByDatacenter

Gets a list of recommended GRE tunnel virtual IP addresses (VIPs), grouped by data center, based on source IP address or latitude/longitude coordinates.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
routableIP
boolean

The routable IP address.

Default value: true
withinCountryOnly
boolean

Search within country only.

Default value: false
includePrivateServiceEdge
boolean

Include ZIA Private Service Edge VIPs.

Default value: true
includeCurrentVips
boolean

Include currently assigned VIPs.

Default value: true
sourceIp
string

The source IP address.

latitude
double

The latitude coordinate of the GRE tunnel source.

longitude
double

The longitude coordinate of the GRE tunnel source.

subcloud
string

The subcloud for the VIP. To learn more see, About Subcloud.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
datacenter
object
greVips
object[]
]
